module.name: hal_tty
module.details: This module defines the transport-independent interface implemented by terminal devices. Terminal implementations provide sequential-stream I/O together with line-discipline attributes, flow and queue control, and window size handling.

interface.name: tty
interface.details: This interface extends a sequential stream with terminal-specific, typed control operations using the attributes and action values defined by @p <termios.h>. It deliberately does not expose ioctl request numbers or untyped argument pointers. Implementations define which optional flags and actions are supported.
interface.note: The inherited stream operations obey the active input and output processing attributes. In canonical mode a zero-length read represents an end-of-file condition.

method.name: ttySetAttributes
method.param: One of @p TCSANOW, @p TCSADRAIN, or @p TCSAFLUSH.
method.retval: An action, flag, or attribute value is not supported.

method.name: ttyDrain
method.brief: Waits until all pending output has been transmitted.

method.name: ttyFlush
method.param: One of @p TCIFLUSH, @p TCOFLUSH, or @p TCIOFLUSH.
method.retval: The queue selector is invalid or unsupported.

method.name: ttyFlow
method.param: One of @p TCOOFF, @p TCOON, @p TCIOFF, or @p TCION.
method.retval: The flow-control action is invalid or unsupported.

method.name: ttyGetWindowSize
method.param: Pointer to the returned window size.

method.name: ttySetWindowSize
method.param: Pointer to the requested window size.
method.retval: The requested window size is invalid or unsupported.
